answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using bottleneck routing over bilateral task receipts. At the dawn of each round, random walks traverse historical interaction graphs to propagate a reputation signal from verified seeds. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of executing sustained, non-collusive trade with honest nodes to bridge network cuts. However, this dynamic isolates new participants, confining influence to an incumbent oasis and impeding permissionless onboarding.
